description: The IoT Technician (Smart Agriculture) will integrate IoT technologies into modern agricultural practices. The course covers electronic measurements, component testing, and programming IoT applications using Python and no-code platforms. Learners gain hands-on experience in sensor interfacing, microcontroller and microprocessor integration, and communication protocols. Emphasis is placed on smart agriculture solutions such as greenhouse automation, soil monitoring, irrigation control, plant health management, and cowshed systems. The qualification also includes training in cloud connectivity, data monitoring, and troubleshooting of IoT networks and devices to enhance productivity and sustainability in agriculture.
